say:1:1123655001:1.text: The Quicksand Claws have become more aggressive lately. They even attempted to cross our borders and seize our land.
say:1:1123655001:1.source_cn: 流沙之爪最近越来越猖狂了，甚至想越过黑嚎氏族的边界，掠...

say:2:1123655002:1.text: Our warriors tried to chase them down, but they always managed to escape with their speed.
say:2:1123655002:1.source_cn: 我们的战士试图追击，但他们太过灵活，每一次都能顺利逃跑。

say:3:1123655003:1.text: We of the Grimmaw Clan are strong but not very fast. Pursuing them poses a challenge to us.
say:3:1123655003:1.source_cn: 黑嚎只擅长力量比拼，却不够灵活，实在难以追击。

say:4:1123655004:1.text: It'd be great if you could help us <style="highlight">patrol the borders</style>.
say:4:1123655004:1.male: It'd be great if you could help us <style="highlight">patrol the borders</style>.
say:4:1123655004:1.female: It'd be great if you could help us <style="highlight">patrol the borders</style>.

say:0:1123656001:0.text: You blasted Claws! Let go of those <style="highlight">terrabirds</style> right now!
say:0:1123656001:0.source_cn: 流沙之爪，你们这群混账！快点放下我们的<style=h...

say:1:1123656002:0.text: Ha! Dream on! Only the strong survive! Isn't that the motto of your clan?
say:1:1123656002:0.source_cn: 哼，你说放我就放？怎么可能！弱者就该被欺负！这就是你们...

say:2:1123656003:0.text: Nobody messes with the Grimmaw Clan! Magister, let's go teach these thugs a lesson!
say:2:1123656003:0.source_cn: 黑嚎才不会任人欺凌！魔法师大人，您来得正好，快来帮帮我们！
say:2:1123656003:0.male: Nobody messes with the Grimmaw Clan! Magister, let's go teach these thugs a lesson!
say:2:1123656003:0.female: Nobody messes with the Grimmaw Clan! Magister, let's go teach these thugs a lesson!

say:3:1123657002:1.text: Remember this little lesson. Don't ever mess with us again!
say:3:1123657002:1.source_cn: 这只是给你的一点教训。记住了，以后别再来找黑嚎的麻烦！

say:4:1123657003:1.text: Hmph! Stop trying to act tough! Look around! Even your terrabird can't stand you and ran off!
say:4:1123657003:1.source_cn: 哼……装什么威风！你自己看看吧，陆行鸟都受不了你，早就跑了！

say:5:1123657004:1.text: What?! My whistle... Where's my terrabird whistle?!
say:5:1123657004:1.source_cn: 什么？！\n哨子……我的陆行鸟哨子去哪了？！

say:6:1123657005:1.text: Magister, please help me find my <style="highlight">whistle</style>!
say:6:1123657005:1.source_cn: 魔法师大人，快帮我找找我的<style=highlig...
say:6:1123657005:1.male: Magister, please help me find my <style="highlight">whistle</style>!
say:6:1123657005:1.female: Magister, please help me find my <style="highlight">whistle</style>!

say:0:1123658001:0.text: The terrabird wandered to the border and caught the Claws' attention.
say:0:1123658001:0.source_cn: 都怪我。都是我哨子用得不熟练，陆行鸟才会跑到氏族边界，...

say:1:1123658002:0.text: Magister, I'm pretty clumsy with my whistle. Can you use it and lure the <style="highlight">terrabird</style> back?
say:1:1123658002:0.source_cn: 不说这些了。魔法师大人，我还不太会用哨子。请您帮帮忙，...
say:1:1123658002:0.male: Magister, I'm pretty clumsy with my whistle. Can you use it and lure the <style="highlight">terrabird</style> back?
say:1:1123658002:0.female: Magister, I'm pretty clumsy with my whistle. Can you use it and lure the <style="highlight">terrabird</style> back?

say:0:1123659001:0.text: Thanks for your help! Let me bring the terrabird back to the pen.
say:0:1123659001:0.source_cn: 多谢您的帮助！我现在就把陆行鸟送回饲养圈。
say:0:1123659001:0.male: Thanks for your help! Let me bring the terrabird back to the pen.
say:0:1123659001:0.female: Thanks for your help! Let me bring the terrabird back to the pen.

say:1:1123659002:0.text: Don't worry. I'll keep the Quicksand Claws at bay as long as I'm around.
say:1:1123659002:0.source_cn: 其余的事您不必担心，有我在，绝对不会让流沙之爪再次入侵...
say:1:1123659002:0.male: Don't worry. I'll keep the Quicksand Claws at bay as long as I'm around.
say:1:1123659002:0.female: Don't worry. I'll keep the Quicksand Claws at bay as long as I'm around.

say:1:1123660001:1.text: Things turned out just as I expected.

say:2:1123660002:1.text: The Quicksand Claws will just push their luck again if we don't make them suffer.
say:2:1123660002:1.source_cn: 不让流沙之爪吃点苦头，他们只会变本加厉。

say:3:1123660003:1.text: I believe they'll lay low for a while because of your presence here. I can't thank you enough.
say:3:1123660003:1.source_cn: 我想，今天看到你之后，他们应该会消停一段时间。真是多亏了你。
say:3:1123660003:1.male: I believe they'll lay low for a while because of your presence here. I can't thank you enough.
say:3:1123660003:1.female: I believe they'll lay low for a while because of your presence here. I can't thank you enough.

say:4:1123660004:1.text: It's time I come up with a way to keep them out of our territory for good.
say:4:1123660004:1.source_cn: 我也该想想办法，让他们彻底远离黑嚎氏族的领地了。
